|gr1= Triggers

|descr= Returns trigger timeout.

|p1= trigger: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [min, mid, max, interruptible]
* min: [[Number]]
* mid: [[Number]]
* max: [[Number]]
* interruptible: [[Boolean]]


|x1= <sqf>_timeOut = triggerTimeout someTrigger;</sqf>

|seealso= [[setTriggerTimeout]] [[triggerTimeoutCurrent]]
